summary: Pull Request: push → PR（題と本文はコミットから。既にあれば作らずにその番号を返す）。結果の outputs に PR の番号（pr）を返す

run: gh pr create --base "$1" --head "$0" --fill >&2 || exit 1; n=$(gh pr view "$0" --json number --jq .number) && [ -n "$n" ] || exit 1; printf '{"status": "ok", "summary": "PR #%s", "items": [{"kind": "pr", "number": %s}], "outputs": {"pr": %s}}\n' "$n" "$n" "$n"
probe: n=$(gh pr list --head "$0" --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty'); [ -n "$n" ] || exit 1; printf '{"status": "ok", "summary": "PR #%s", "items": [{"kind": "pr", "number": %s}], "outputs": {"pr": %s}}\n' "$n" "$n" "$n"
